RawHydroBoundary.description: Boundary values of one hydro plant.

hydro_id.description: Hydro plant identifier. Must be unique within `hydros`.

past_defluences.description:
Past release windows of the plant, on the pre-study calendar. Windows
must not overlap; adjacent windows (start == previous end) are
accepted. Optional; defaults to empty.

recent_inflows.description:
Observed inflow for partial periods before the study start. Windows
must not overlap; adjacent windows (start == previous end) are
accepted. Optional; defaults to empty.

storage_hm3.description: Reservoir volume at the study start (hm³). Must be >= 0.0. Optional.

RawPostStudyBound.description: Cost and generation bounds for one post-study stage of a thermal plant.

cost_per_mwh.description: Fuel cost (`$/MWh`) at this stage. Must be finite.

max_mw.description:
Upper bound of the delivered MW rate at this stage. Must be finite and
`>= min_mw`.

min_mw.description: Lower bound of the delivered MW rate at this stage. Must be finite.

stage_id.description: Id of an entry of `post_study_thermal_stages` in `stages.json`.

RawThermalBoundary.description: Boundary values of one thermal plant.

commitments.description:
Committed MW windows decided before the study, covering the leading
in-study delivery stages or the post-horizon deliveries. Windows must
not overlap or share a `start_date`; adjacent windows (start ==
previous end) are accepted. Optional; defaults to empty.

post_study_bounds.description:
Cost and generation bounds per post-study stage the study decides. A
`stage_id` may appear once per plant. Optional; defaults to empty.

thermal_id.description: Thermal plant identifier. Must be unique within `thermals`.

RawWindowM3s.description: A `[start_date, end_date)` window carrying a flow rate in m³/s.

end_date.description:
End of the window (exclusive), as an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be
after `start_date`.

start_date.description: Start of the window (inclusive), as an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD).

value_m3s.description: Average rate over the window (m³/s). Must be finite.

RawWindowMw.description: A `[start_date, end_date)` window carrying a power rate in MW.

end_date.description:
End of the window (exclusive), as an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Must be
after `start_date`.

start_date.description: Start of the window (inclusive), as an ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD).

value_mw.description: Committed rate held constant over the window (MW). Must be finite.

$schema.description: JSON schema URI — informational, not validated.

hydros.description:
Boundary values per hydro plant. A plant with none may be left out.
Optional; defaults to empty.

thermals.description:
Boundary values per thermal plant. A plant with none may be left out.
Optional; defaults to empty.
